purpose: Reference for 3D registration of human skin tissue samples; no sample is assumed to belong to a specific hand without measured registration.

source.name: 3D reconstruction of skin and spatial mapping of immune cell density, vascular distance and effects of sun exposure and aging

limitations: Skin samples are not automatically hand samples.
A tissue-to-hand transform must be measured or otherwise validated before assigning a sample to a hand region.
This metadata does not contain a fabricated transform.
